name: Apache APISIX
description: Shows the routes an Apache APISIX gateway publishes: host names, the upstream (also through a shared upstream or a service), redirects, whether a route is switched off, and the TLS certificates with their expiry date. Read-only: it only sends GET requests, with the key of the built-in viewer role.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
